<description>
Picked from #35302 as an isolated change that can be evaluated independently. This should make #35302 a bit easier to review. This adds a Python implementation of BIP352 scanning, without labels, so the functional tests can check silent payments outputs independently of `bitcoind` support. It is tested against the BIP352 receiving test vectors.

When a Coinbase TX is supplied, txid will be `000...00`, and `getrawtransaction` will fail with `test_framework.util.JSONRPCException: No such mempool or blockchain transaction. Use gettransaction for wallet transactions. (-5)`.

Not sure what approach is most appropriate here; on the one hand, a user shouldn't try to scan a coinbase tx, and maybe the code should crash and force the user to adjust the test, but I also see this happening when a user tries to scan a block, and an argument could be made that the function should simply skip a coinbase tx the way the production scanning function would.
